tha-ap39:1.1: Lasuṇadāyaka.] Himavantass' avidūre tāpaso ās' ahaṃ tadā / lasuṇaṃ upajivāmi lasuṇaṃ mayhaṃ bhojanaṃ. // //
tha-ap39:2.1: Khāriyo pūrayitvāna saṅghārāmaṃ agañch' ahaṃ / haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena saṅghassa lasuṇaṃ adaṃ. // //
tha-ap39:3.1: Vipassissa naraggassa sāsane niratass' ahaṃ / saṅghassa lasuṇaṃ datvā kappaṃ saggamhi mod' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap39:4.1: Ekanavute ito kappe lasuṇaṃ yam adan tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi lasuṇānaṃ idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap39:5.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap39:6.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Lasuṇadāyako thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
